review_scope: Only the five named works; primary papers/venue pages/author repositories; not an exhaustive novelty search.

claim_labels.AUTHOR_REAL_GPU: Published authors' measurements; not independently reproduced here.
claim_labels.AUTHOR_EVENT_DRIVEN_SIMULATION_AND_PPA_E: Modeled future design; not measured chip speedup/energy.
claim_labels.OUR_INFERENCE: Planning collision/exclusion; no compatible local asset or runtime qualification implied.

papers.title: Strata: Hierarchical Context Caching for Long Context Language Model Serving
papers.version_note: Use OSDI final. arXiv2508.18572v1 is 2025 preprint; its abstract describes a TTFT5x claim while final abstract reports throughput. Do not mix.
papers.innovation: GPU-assisted hierarchical KV transfer/layout plus cache-aware scheduling; existing SGLang software.
papers.model_input_identity: Llama3.1-8B/70B-Instruct; Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-1M. LooGLE-Wikipedia/NarrativeQA/ReviewMT/ShareGPT; Poisson arrivals, concurrency cap128.
identity_gaps: No model revision or frozen input-byte SHA.
No authors' GPU-hours/complete benchmark resource receipt.

groups.device: H200:8GPU platform/1.6TB CPU RAM; models8B/14B use1GPU,70B TP4. H20-storage and GH200 separate.
groups.result: Llama70B LooGLE: up to5x vs vLLM-LMCache,3.75x vs TRT-HiCache at equal TTFT.
groups.scope: Serving throughput/TTFT; warm hierarchy separately precomputed; not pure decode.

groups.device: H200 transfer/compute co-run; H20+P5510 disk. Cache-distance study uses simulated arrivals/execution.
groups.control: Copy layout/pages, IO-only vs scheduling, transfer-block quota,cache distance/disk layout.
groups.scope: Kernel resources matter; cache-distance simulation is not a realGPU performance run.

groups.device: GH200 H100+Grace vs H200 PCIe5; Llama8B/LooGLE.
groups.control: Standard DMA vs StrataIO; scheduler; infinite-bandwidth oracle.
groups.result: Sustained StrataIO ~40.3GB/s PCIe,150.5GB/s GH; scheduling still necessary.
groups.scope: Oracle is estimate; faster link alone does not establish useful app speedup.

papers.our_inference_Q2: Direct collision: KV placement/migration/layout and overlap already strong software. Residual must survive current HiCache, batchedDMA and IO-kernel interference controls.
papers.our_inference_Q3: Indirect only: KV tiering is not expert routing/weight residency.

papers.precision: NOT_EXPLICITLY_PINNED; pruning/retrieval changes attention contents, not bit-exact full cache.

groups.result: Quality mostly maintained; not exact output equivalence.
groups.scope: Multimodal task scores; not dense text decode contract.

groups.result: All-static34.13 vs hybrid38.65 vs all-dynamic48.15ms/token;quality differs.

papers.our_inference_Q2: Direct capacity/migration collision, but lossy semantic change needs a separate quality contract. Compare retained-KV residency,CPU traffic,index cost,not advertised memory ratio alone.

global_missing_authority: A cited paper/model name does not authorize downloading or executing that model.
No supplied source establishes an accepted second-model local tensor/input authority.
No paper result is directly substituted for RTX4080 BF16 native performance or numerical gates.

planning_collision.Q2: Require a real capacity transition and exact source/request/cache state, then compare current tiered-cache software and expose remaining migration/index/IO-contention cost.
planning_collision.Q3: Require naturally produced routing and strong fusion/prefetch/placement baseline; charge metadata, duplicate capacity, conversion, communication and full application time. Do not synthesize expert hotspots.

resource_receipt.scope: Focused literature agent; short-lived CPU Python and pdftotext. Own observed RSS only, not continuous all-agent tree.
